internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Diverse engineering skills, robotics and transport – you’ll find it all at Riihimäki campus. The campus offers both Finnish and English-language engineering courses, graduating future all-rounders. In addition to teaching, the campus also hosts a lot of research work.
A truly international learning environment can be found in Valkeakoski! Located in the South Pirkanmaa region of Finland, our Valkeakoski campus is modern and community-oriented.
